name: Setting Goals You'll Actually Achieve
instructions: Write goals in terms of a specific action you control, not just an outcome you hope for.
Connect each goal to a real reason it matters to you -- vague goals without a "why" are the easiest to abandon.
Set one goal for this month rather than five, so your attention is not spread too thin to make progress on any of them.
Watch today's video for a full framework on setting goals that stick.
